content.body:
With twenty kilograms of high explosives and eight grenades, engineers carry a significant amount of destructive power. These HE satchels are primarily used to destroy forward bases, bridges and other structures.
Engineers also can repair bridges and AI emplacements. This often overlooked ability can be critically important when the success or failure of an attack depends on a crucial downed bridge.
content.brief: WEAPON: Lee-Enfield No.4 Mk I Rifle AMMO: .303 cal (7.7 mm) British Mk VII Ball MAGAZINE: 10 rounds (two stripper clips) MUZZLE VELOCITY: 751 m/s RATE OF FIRE: Single-round bolt action OTHER EQUIPMENT: Demolition (HE) Satchel Charges (4) No.36 Mills Bomb HE Grenades (4) No.77 Mk I Smoke Grenades (4) Bridge Repair Kits (4) Combat Knife
